aka.zh: 台 9 线苏澳至大清水段（至 2018—2020 年）

tagline.en: The cliff road from Su'ao down the Pacific coast to Heren, left behind in pieces when the Suhua tunnels took over Highway 9 and kept for cyclists, motorcyclists and the view
tagline.zh: 自苏澳沿太平洋断崖南下至和仁的旧路；苏花改隧道接手台 9 线后分段留存，供自行车、机车与观景之用

end.en: Heren, Xiulin, Hualien, at the Kanan bridge by the south portal of the Zhongren tunnel
end.zh: 花莲县秀林乡和仁，中仁隧道南口卡那岸桥

en: Provincial Highway 9D is what was left of the Suhua Highway on Highway 9 when the Suhua improvement tunnels opened. It runs 64.262 km in three pieces of old road: Su'ao to Dong'ao, about 17 km over the Zhengdao bridge and past the Wuyanjiao lookout; Nan'ao to Heping; and Hezhong to Heren. Between Dong'ao and Nan'ao and between Heping and Hezhong it shares the road with Highway 9. It is the third-longest provincial spur.

The northern piece is the best known. From Su'ao it climbs to the Zhengdao bridge, the highest point near the sea, then runs along the cliff with views down to Nanfang'ao harbour and Dong'ao bay. The directorate's Fourth District office has promoted it as a Pacific scenic road, and has turned roadside space into rest stops for cyclists.
zh: 台 9 丁线是苏花改隧道通车后，原台 9 线苏花公路留下的旧路。全长 64.262 公里，由三段旧路组成：苏澳至东澳约 17 公里，经正岛桥与乌岩角观景台；南澳至和平；和中至和仁。东澳至南澳、和平至和中两段与台 9 线共线。它是第三长的省道支线。
北段最为人熟知。自苏澳爬升至临海最高处的正岛桥，再沿断崖而行，可俯瞰南方澳渔港与东澳湾。公路总局第四区养护工程处将其定位为太平洋景观道路，并把路旁空地整理为自行车骑士的休憩驿站。

en: This is the road whose history is told under Highway 9: the Qing Northern Road of 1874, the Japanese cliff road, decades of one-way convoys and two-way traffic from 1990. A shrine at about 14 km, the Qing'an temple, keeps a stone to those killed building the road, begun after an explosion during the Japanese works and now bearing 13 names, among them two Japanese engineers of 1922 and two of the directorate's own staff.

Typhoon Megi on 21 October 2010 decided its fate. Su'ao had 939 mm of rain in a day, and the road between 112 and 116 km collapsed in several places. A tour coach carrying 19 visitors from Guangdong with a Taiwanese driver and guide went into the sea near 114.5 km; another coach was hit at 112.8 km and a car buried at 112.1 km. Twenty-six people were dead or missing, about 400 were stranded, and a 500 m stretch of roadbed between 115 and 116 km sank about 20 m. A memorial to the 26 stands at the Wuyanjiao lookout at about 11.4 km, put up in 2011.

Work on the Suhua improvement began in 2011. On 28 January 2016 an Executive Yuan announcement renumbered the old road from 103 to 171.6 km as Highway 9D, Su'ao to Daqingshui, 68.6 km, with the change applied as each section of the new road opened. The Su'ao–Dong'ao tunnels opened on 5 February 2018, when old 104.8–120.5 km became 9D at 1.8–17.5 km; the southern sections followed on 6 January 2020. On 12 January 2026 a further announcement gave up the stretch from Heren to Daqingshui and renamed the route Su'ao–Heren, 64.262 km.
zh: 这就是台 9 线条目中所述的那条路：1874 年清代北路、日治时期的断崖道路、数十年的单向管制车队，以及 1990 年起的双向通车。约 14 公里处的庆安堂供奉“开路先锋爷”石碑，纪念修路殉职者；石碑起于日治大正年间工程爆炸事故，如今刻有 13 人姓名，其中包括 1922 年开辟东海徒步道的两名日本工程师，以及公路单位的吴锦文段长、丁培俊监工员。

2010 年 10 月 21 日的梅姬台风决定了它的命运。苏澳单日雨量达 939 毫米，112 至 116 公里间多处崩塌。一辆载有 19 名广东旅客及台湾司机、导游的游览车在约 114.5 公里处坠海；另一辆游览车在 112.8 公里处被击中，一辆小客车在 112.1 公里处遭掩埋。共 26 人死亡或失踪，约 400 人受困，115 至 116 公里间约 500 米路基下陷约 20 米。2011 年在约 11.4 公里的乌岩角观景台设立苏花公路安魂碑，悼念 26 名罹难者。

苏花改于 2011 年动工。2016 年 1 月 28 日行政院公告（院台交字第 1050002478 号），原台 9 线 103 至 171.6 公里改编为台 9 丁线，路线名称苏澳至大清水，里程 68.6 公里，随新路各段通车而实施。苏澳至东澳段于 2018 年 2 月 5 日通车，原 104.8 至 120.5 公里改为台 9 丁线 1.8 至 17.5 公里；南段于 2020 年 1 月 6 日通车。2026 年 1 月 12 日再度公告，废止和仁至大清水段，路线名称改为苏澳至和仁，全长 64.262 公里。

en: Megi's damage took years to settle. On 27 October 2011 heavy rain brought down the slope below the road at 115.8 km; traffic had already been controlled because of cracks, and a temporary two-lane fix was finished in January 2012. The Dakeng bridge at 115.9 km was rebuilt and opened on 20 September 2012. Typhoon Saola closed the road from 2 to 10 August 2012. The old Dong'ao bridge, with a 90-degree bend and a 10.6 per cent grade at its north end, was replaced between March 2011 and July 2012 by a 267 m bridge.

From 2011 the directorate managed the road by rainfall: cumulative rain triggers yellow, orange and red levels for warning, alert and closure. In 2019 rockfall alarms using infrared and vibration sensors were put up at 9.8 km and 12.5 km. Since 2020 the old road has been fitted for cycling, with raised guardrails along the cycle lane, and when the new Suhua road is closed for works traffic is sent back onto 9D.
zh: 梅姬风灾的后续影响延续多年。2011 年 10 月 27 日连日豪雨造成 115.8 公里处下边坡大规模坍滑，所幸事先已因路面裂缝实施交通管制；2012 年 1 月完成临时抢通，恢复双线通车。115.9 公里的大坑桥改建，于 2012 年 9 月 20 日通车。2012 年 8 月 2 日至 10 日，苏拉台风使本路封闭。旧东澳桥北端为 90 度急弯、坡度 10.6%，2011 年 3 月至 2012 年 7 月改建为长 267 米的新桥。
2011 年起，公路总局以累积雨量管理本路：降雨指标达黄色进行预警，橙色进行警戒，红色实施管制。2019 年在 9.8 公里与 12.5 公里处设置利用红外线及碰触震动侦测的落石告警系统。2020 年起旧路陆续改善为自行车道路，加高自行车道护栏；新苏花公路施工封闭时，车流改道回到台 9 丁线。

en: Speed limits are 30 to 50 km/h. Most through traffic now takes the Suhua improvement; the old road carries local traffic, cyclists, and the motorcycles that the 2020 opening rules kept out of most of the new tunnels. The best viewpoints are the Zhengdao bridge and the Wuyanjiao lookout on the Su'ao–Dong'ao piece, and the cliff above Dong'ao bay.
zh: 全线限速每小时 30 至 50 公里。大多数过境车辆已改走苏花改；旧路承载地方交通、自行车，以及 2020 年通车规定中不得进入大部分新隧道的机车。最佳观景点为苏澳至东澳段的正岛桥与乌岩角观景台，以及东澳湾上方的断崖。

why.en: No cost is published for the old road, built in stages from the Japanese era onward. The Suhua improvement that replaced it is priced under Highway 9.
why.zh: 旧路自日治时期起分阶段修筑，未见造价公布。取代它的苏花改，其经费见台 9 线条目。

why.en: Maintained in the central highway budget through the Highway Bureau's Fourth District office (now its Eastern Maintenance Branch); no breakdown for the spur has been published.
why.zh: 由公路局第四区养护工程处（今东区养护工程分局）以中央公路预算养护；未见本支线的出资构成公布。

value.en: 68.6 km in the 2016 announcement; 69.1 km in the directorate's 2019 account; 64.262 km since 12 January 2026

figures.source: Executive Yuan announcements 院臺交字第1050002478號 (28 January 2016) and 院臺交字第1141038665號 (12 January 2026); DGH Fourth District Maintenance Office seventieth-anniversary book (2019)

label.zh: 梅姬台风（2010 年 10 月 21 日）

value.en: 939 mm of rain in a day at Su'ao; 26 dead or missing; about 400 stranded
value.zh: 苏澳单日雨量 939 毫米；26 人死亡或失踪；约 400 人受困

figures.source: Taipei Times, 23 October 2010; DGH Fourth District Maintenance Office seventieth-anniversary book (2019); as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 蘇花公路土石流事故

value.zh: 约 391.9 万元（2020 年招标）；2023 年再以约 528 万元改善自行车道与警示系统

figures.source: Government e-procurement records, DGH Fourth District Maintenance Office

timeline.en: Typhoon Megi on 21 October: collapses between 112 and 116 km, 26 dead or missing.
timeline.zh: 10 月 21 日梅姬台风：112 至 116 公里多处崩塌，26 人死亡或失踪。

timeline.en: The Suhua improvement begins; the Wuyanjiao memorial is put up; 115.8 km slides again on 27 October.
timeline.zh: 苏花改动工；乌岩角安魂碑设立；10 月 27 日 115.8 公里再度坍滑。

timeline.en: The new Dong'ao bridge is finished in July and the Dakeng bridge opens on 20 September.
timeline.zh: 7 月新东澳桥竣工，9 月 20 日大坑桥通车。

timeline.en: On 28 January the Executive Yuan renumbers the old road as Highway 9D, 68.6 km.
timeline.zh: 1 月 28 日，行政院公告将旧路改编为台 9 丁线，68.6 公里。

timeline.en: The Su'ao–Dong'ao tunnels open on 5 February; the old road there becomes 9D.
timeline.zh: 2 月 5 日，苏澳至东澳新路通车，该段旧路改为台 9 丁线。

timeline.en: Rockfall alarms are installed at 9.8 km and 12.5 km.
timeline.zh: 9.8 公里与 12.5 公里处设置落石告警系统。

timeline.en: The southern Suhua sections open on 6 January; the rest of the old road becomes 9D.
timeline.zh: 1 月 6 日苏花改南段通车，其余旧路改为台 9 丁线。

timeline.en: On 12 January Heren–Daqingshui is given up; the route becomes Su'ao–Heren, 64.262 km.
timeline.zh: 1 月 12 日，和仁至大清水段废止，路线改为苏澳至和仁，64.262 公里。
